domain_title: Accountability, evidence, risk decisions and lifecycle governance
title: Ownership and accountable operating model
canonical_definition: One accountable system owner and clearly assigned business, technical, data, model, security, privacy, operations and decision roles exercise authority throughout the lifecycle.

conditions: Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are accountable ownership, delegated responsibilities, decision rights and continuity obligations defined?
Are ownership and role assignments embedded in work queues, access, reviews, incidents and change processes?
Do records show that named owners act, resolve gaps and remain accountable after deployment?

conditions: Refer a material failure of ownership and accountable operating model to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 2.1 (PDF p. 28), GOVERN 2.3 (PDF p. 28)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on assigning operational responsibilities and executive responsibility for risk decisions. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make ownership and accountable operating model verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: F1 evaluates ownership and accountable operating model using evidence from intent through operation. AP-F1 independently assesses evidence of committee accountability without individual ownership.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies an operating model naming an accountable individual, decision rights, delegated duties and succession. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.
The current release demonstrates ownership wired to work queues, privileges, on-call coverage, review and incident escalation. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides sampled cases show the named owner accepted accountability, resolved overdue duties and arranged continuity during absence. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in ownership and accountable operating model, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide an operating model naming an accountable individual, decision rights, delegated duties and succession. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate ownership wired to work queues, privileges, on-call coverage, review and incident escalation. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide sampled cases show the named owner accepted accountability, resolved overdue duties and arranged continuity during absence. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how ownership and accountable operating model works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with an operating model naming an accountable individual, decision rights, delegated duties and succession. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use sampled cases show the named owner accepted accountability, resolved overdue duties and arranged continuity during absence to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A committee can provide review when a specific individual retains operational accountability and acts on decisions.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-F1 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in ownership and accountable operating model
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in ownership and accountable operating model
Evidence remains insufficient for ownership and accountable operating model in the assessed scope
